title: Landing-page hero and offer for finance teams
scenario:
TOPIC: Write landing-page copy for an invoice reconciliation service
Create the top section of a landing page for finance managers at 20-to-100-person agencies who reconcile invoices in spreadsheets every Friday. The service imports bank and invoice files and returns an exception list within one business day for ₹25,000 per month. The first five customers receive a 14-day pilot and may leave without paying if the exception list is unusable. Write to that one persona, lead with the costly problem, present the complete offer and deadline, use one CTA, avoid invented proof, explain why the copy works, handle the top objections, and include one A/B hero variant.

expected_elements.name: risk reversal
expected_elements.pattern: 14[- ]day pilot|leave without paying|don't pay|do not pay|guarantee

bad_signs.name: invented customer proof
bad_signs.pattern: trusted by|hundreds of agencies|our customers save|proven results

improvement_suggestions: Lead with the recurring manual burden in the buyer's own language.
Present the paid deliverable against the cost of the existing process.
Remove extra actions and unsupported claims from the page.
